answer.evidence: radon/raw.py:72-79 defines `_find(tokens, token, value)`. It iterates `reversed(tokens)` and compares `(token, value)` to `token_values[:2]`. On a match it returns `len(tokens) - index - 1`, which is the original index of the rightmost match. If nothing matches it raises `ValueError('(token, value) pair not found')`. A grep for raise statements and find-style function names in complexity.py, metrics.py and visitors.py found nothing related. complexity.py only raises a ValueError for negative complexity values.
